when_to_use: Concurrent message-passing stateful entities; worker pools, relays, supervisors, state machines; need mailbox semantics with request/reply patterns
when_not_to: Single-threaded sequential code (use fn); shared-memory concurrency (use collapse/observe with atomics); simple async/await; just want a thread

when_to_use: Managing raw memory (ptr<T>) with explicit aliasing control; need compiler verification of exclusive mutation -> read-only observation -> deterministic teardown; ownership state machine matters for safety
when_not_to: Normal stack variables (automatic); world state (has own ownership model); actor state (actors own it); no raw pointers (nothing to own)

when_to_use: Parallel write lanes on disjoint pointer regions; SIMD-style parallel reductions
when_not_to: Single-threaded write patterns; no parallelism needed

when_to_use: Non-owning pointer alias that must not be decayed; observer pointers outliving the owner
Code depends on target/architecture/capability that may not be present; need declared fallback path; capability gate visible in runtime contract for orchestrate guarded by clauses
when_not_to: Capability is always present; simple platform check (use converge); just documentation (use comments)

when_to_use: Hot data where field lanes accessed independently (SoA beats AoS for SIMD/GPU); preparing data for GPU upload or SIMD processing; compiler should track lane layout metadata
when_not_to: Normal struct with mixed access patterns; small structs fitting cache lines; no performance evidence SoA matters

when_to_use: Moving data from one world to another without copying; source should be considered moved (post-teleport reads are compile errors); want runtime to track handoff as machine stone event
when_not_to: Just passing a value between functions (use parameters); both worlds should keep data (use entangle); want a copy (just assign or clone)

when_to_use: Timing/recurrence is part of program semantics; want jitter-tolerant periodic execution (frame loops, physics ticks, LFO modulation, heartbeat); want runtime-owned scheduling, not hand-rolled while+sleep; need pulse_tick/pulse_dt_ms/pulse_missed for accurate timing
when_not_to: One-shot timer (use async+timer or ask_timeout); tight spin loop (use while+raw timing); event-driven callback (use resonate or actor on handlers)

when_to_use: World field change should trigger handler without polling; want dampening to absorb rapid-fire changes; reaction should be compiler-owned post-store shadow patch; want direct LLVM lowering not indirect dispatch
when_not_to: Want to poll the value (read in pulse or loop); reaction simple enough to inline; need complex event routing (actor message handlers)

when_to_use: Pipeline of dependent stages across different runtimes (CPU -> GPU -> law check -> patch -> world); stages need explicit dependencies, residency, transfer, fallback paths, guard axioms; want compiler validation of dependency graph; want runtime telemetry
when_not_to: Linear sequence of function calls (plain fn); all stages same runtime with no interesting residency/transfer; just want to call a GPU function (use dispatch directly)

when_to_use: Reference implementation plus platform-specific optimized versions; optimization gated by target() or capability(); need compiler/runtime to select best lane automatically; need verify random(N) to fuzz-test fast lanes against spec
when_not_to: Only one implementation (use fn); fast path same code as spec (use fn); doing if target==windows inside fn

when_to_use: Constraint that must hold for correctness (bounds, ranges, valid states); invariant should be compiler-witnessable not hidden in an if; want invariant part of runtime contract; want Z3 able to prove invariant
when_not_to: One-off check in function body (use if); business logic not invariant (use fn); doesn't return Bool (law must return Bool)

when_to_use: Mutation should be recorded in patch journal (auditability, replay, undo); mutation targets world state fields; want runtime telemetry; mutation might be part of orchestrate pipeline stage
when_not_to: Setting a local variable (just assign); modifying struct field not world state (use impl methods); mutation doesn't need tracking

when_to_use: Two world fields should stay in sync automatically; need single-writer semantics (one writes, other reads); want compiler to track propagation counts and coupling metadata
when_not_to: Syncing two local variables (just assign); need bidirectional writes (entangle is single_writer only); just passing data between functions (use parameters)

when_to_use: Default baseline for all Kain code; no higher-layer construct fits
when_not_to: When any Layer 1-7 construct fits; patch is not a function that writes to a global; law is not an if statement; converge is not a function with #[cfg]
